requirements.statement: Users sign in via single sign-on before using the app

criteria.must: An unauthenticated user is prompted to sign in before reaching list/task data
A successfully signed-in user reaches their lists

requirements.statement: A signed-in user can create a shared to-do list

criteria.must: Creating a list with a name succeeds and the list appears in the creator's list of lists
The creator is recorded as the list's owner

requirements.statement: A list owner can invite another person to their list by email

criteria.must: The owner can submit an email address to invite someone to a list they own
A non-owner member cannot invite others to the list

requirements.statement: An invited user can accept an invitation to join a list

criteria.must: A user whose account email matches a pending invitation sees that invitation
Accepting the invitation adds the user as a member and grants them visibility of the list's tasks
A user can decline an invitation instead of accepting it

requirements.statement: A member can add a task with a title, due date, and priority

criteria.must: Adding a task with a title succeeds
A task can be given a due date
A task can be given a priority level

requirements.statement: A member can mark a task done or not-done, visible to all members

criteria.must: Marking a task done updates its status for every member viewing the list
A done task can be marked not-done again

requirements.statement: A member can edit or delete a task

criteria.must: Editing a task's title, due date, or priority saves the change
Deleting a task removes it from the list for all members

requirements.statement: Members can see who added and who completed each task

criteria.must: Each task displays the identity of the member who added it
A completed task displays the identity of the member who completed it

requirements.statement: Members can sort and filter tasks by due date or priority

criteria.must: The task list can be sorted by due date
The task list can be sorted by priority
The task list can be filtered by priority level

requirements.statement: A list owner can remove a member from a list they own

criteria.must: The owner can remove a member and that member loses access to the list
A non-owner member cannot remove another member

requirements.statement: A member can leave a shared list they no longer want to be part of

criteria.must: A member can leave a list and it no longer appears in their list of lists
After leaving, the former member can no longer view or modify the list's tasks
